alalal-c47232-d1e101.summary: Rubric marking the third textual division of Distinction 37.

alalal-c47232-d1e108.summary: Divides the third section of the first part ('Ex praedictis patet quod Deus ubique') into three chapters: Lombard shows that something unintelligible is contained in these words, namely the spiritual effects God works in each creature, which exceed human knowledge; he presents a deficient exposition of some ('Quidam tamen immensa'); and he asks whether God can be defiled by the filth of those in whom he is ('Solet etiam ab eisdem quaeri').
claims: The manner of God's presence and operation in creatures exceeds human understanding.

alalal-c47232.summary: Division of the third section of the first part of Distinction 37. Lombard notes that the manner of God's presence, as it concerns the spiritual effects he works in each creature, exceeds human understanding. He reports a deficient exposition of omnipresence by some, and asks whether God can be defiled by the impurity of the things he is in.
claims: The mode of God's presence and operation in creatures exceeds human understanding.
